attrs.mechanism: Agent hypothesis. For block input x and existing convolutional update y, replace x+y with x+2*sigmoid(w*x+b)*y, using broadcast per-channel trainable vectors w and b initialized to zero. The generated control uses x+2*sigmoid(w*y+b)*y with identical parameter shapes and initialization. Both gates initially equal one; the contrast tests whether conditioning on the incoming state helps beyond conditioning on the update.
